agent_contract.keep: Minor boundary contact is allowed. Walking-route flags around steps, doors and arcades do not justify deleting buildings.
agent_contract.exclude: Only a severe vehicle or building conflict that remains after bounded translation and reasonable horizontal scaling; retain the source record and measured reason. Never use the exclusion budget as a target.
agent_contract.input_evidence: Current actual meshes, predicted structures, background surfaces and supplied route geometry. Building ground-truth identities or footprints are not required.
